As Apple INC (AAPL) Stock Value Declined, Shareholder Fmr LLC Decreased Its Position
May 26, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Investors sentiment increased to 0.73 in 2017 Q4. Its up 0.03, from 0.7 in 2017Q3. It is positive, as 50 investors sold AAPL shares while 1023 reduced holdings. 151 funds opened positions while 637 raised stakes. 2.98 billion shares or 0.18% more from 2.97 billion shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Mckinley Carter Wealth Svcs holds 1.59% or 27,301 shares. Autus Asset Mngmt Ltd Co invested in 2.21% or 71,453 shares.
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 insider buys, and 10 sales for $47.05 million activity. Shares for $6.51M were sold by LEVINSON ARTHUR D on Wednesday, May 9. Another trade for 15,653 shares valued at $2.90M was made by WILLIAMS JEFFREY E on Tuesday, May 8. $910,129 worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) shares were sold by KONDO CHRIS. AHRENDTS ANGELA J also sold $6.75 million worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Thursday, May 3. SCHILLER PHILIP W sold $11.56 million worth of stock. On Thursday, April 12 the insider Maestri Luca sold $6.83 million.
Fmr Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 16.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fmr Llc sold 23.77 million shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 121.72M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $20.60B, down from 145.49M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fmr Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Fmr Llc, which manages about $853.06 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Donnelley Finl Solutions Inc by 924,838 shares to 3.75M shares, valued at $73.10 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Innospec Inc (NASDAQ:IOSP) by 171,925 shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.67M shares, and has risen its stake in Sps Comm Inc (NASDAQ:SPSC).
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76B for 21.53 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
